definitions.explanation: A person who studies and researches history as an academic discipline. Refers specifically to professional or academic historians rather than casual history enthusiasts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{歴史|れきし}{学者|がくしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{講演|こうえん}→講演：02735_kouen⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A famous historian gave a lecture.

examples.japanese: {歴史|れきし}{学者|がくしゃ}たち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かれている→分かれる：10976_wakareru⟧。
examples.english: Even among historians, opinions are divided.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{歴史|れきし}{学者|がくしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{近代|きんだい}→近代：02663_kindai⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{転換点|てんかんてん}→転換点：09951_tenkanten⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{見|み}なしている→見なす：10615_minasu⟧。
examples.english: Many historians regard this incident as a turning point in modern Japan.

notes:
The standard compound for a professional historian or history scholar. Follows the productive pattern of field + ⟦{学者|がくしゃ}→学者：02544_gakusha⟧ (scholar).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歴史|れきし}{学者|がくしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{見解|けんかい}→見解：02743_kenkai⟧: a historian's view
- {歴史|れきし}{学者|がくしゃ}⟦によると→〜によると：03104_niyoruto⟧: according to historians
- ⟦{著名|ちょめい}→著名：13992_chomei⟧な{歴史|れきし}{学者|がくしゃ}: a renowned historian

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {史家|しか}: historian — more literary and concise synonym
- {歴史家|れきしか}: historian — slightly less formal variant
- ⟦{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}→研究者：02573_kenkyuusha⟧: researcher — broader term for any academic researcher

FORMS:
⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧ (history) + ⟦{学者|がくしゃ}→学者：02544_gakusha⟧ (scholar). Same pattern as ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦{学者|がくしゃ}→学者：02544_gakusha⟧ (economist), ⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧⟦{学者|がくしゃ}→学者：02544_gakusha⟧ (political scientist), etc.
